title: Crow Stile
shortDescription: A stile of wet stone between ditch and barrow.
longDescription:
A stile of flat stones crosses from the ditch toward the barrow mouth. Crows have used the top stone. They are ordinary crows, smaller than the fold's mist-crow, and they leave when you arrive.
South is the ditch. West is the barrow mouth.

fixtures.name: Stile Stone
fixtures.lookDescription: The top stone of the stile. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Crow chalk, not abbey chalk. Kern would say these birds are only birds. West is the barrow if Wren has already sent you. Do not skip her.
